truth: CORE-01, CORE-03 and CORE-04 are closed as construction dependencies. CORE-02 and PLATFORM-00 remain preserved incomplete.

DAW-00A Peer Host Identity, DAW-00B Stable Workspace Identity and DAW-00C Universal FocusContext are implemented on stacked mergeable draft PRs #30-#32. DAW-00D Bounded Host Shadow is implemented on mergeable draft PR #33 head 17706aba2b765698945f9cb5c20c29bf78011328; hosted exact-head workflows are UNOBSERVED.

Global reselection chose DAW-00E because DAW-00D created a verified host-side truth surface that can legitimately disagree with canonical Song technical memory, making silent conflict resolution the next direct trust hazard.

DAW-00E is the only active increment. Reconciliation compares canonical TECHNICAL Twin claims with CURRENT Host Shadow through an explicit key mapping; Creative Twin intent is not flattened into technical synchronization.
Comparison outcomes distinguish MATCH, HOST_ONLY, SONG_ONLY, CONFLICT and UNRESOLVED. No source, actor or side receives automatic truth priority.
A reconciliation case is opened only for a non-MATCH comparison and snapshots exact canonical claim IDs/values plus exact Host Shadow baseline/latest batch IDs and host-fact provenance.
Choices UPDATE_SONG, RESTORE_HOST, KEEP_WORKSPACE_SPECIFIC and DO_NOTHING are decision receipts only. They do not execute a host mutation or create/supersede canonical evidence.
UPDATE_SONG requires a snapped host fact; RESTORE_HOST requires exactly one snapped canonical technical value. Missing source truth cannot be hidden by an execution-like decision label.

A canonical claim-set change, Host Shadow baseline/latest change or Host Shadow becoming non-current makes the case STALE. Stale cases cannot receive new decisions and must be reopened from current evidence.
A DECIDED case remains pending/visible because decision is not execution or verification.

The DAW-00E reconciliation semantic harness passed 24/24 adversarial cases before publication. Repository Headquarters regressions are authored. Full branch execution could not be run in the local container because github.com DNS resolution is unavailable; hosted exact-head execution has not yet been observed.
No named DAW adapter, DAW mutation, automatic Song update, feature registry, Musical IR/compiler, watcher/poller, UI or platform packaging is included in DAW-00E.
The repeated Drive stale-receipt-body defect is now guarded operationally: every selection change rewrites the complete receipt row atomically rather than changing only title/status.
Historical Ableton implementation maturity continues to provide zero scheduling priority.
Direct legacy source/test-text copying remains blocked by LICENSE-GATE-001.
